people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

translations.web: His return was to Ramah, for his house was there; and he judged Israel there; and he built an altar to Yahweh there.
translations.bsb: Then he would return to Ramah because his home was there, and there he judged Israel and built an altar to the LORD.
translations.kjv: And his return was to Ramah; for there was his house; and there he judged Israel; and there he built an altar unto the LORD.
translations.asv: And his return was to Ramah, for there was his house; and there he judged Israel: and he built there an altar unto Jehovah.
